verdict.rationale: Luma documents text-to-video generation, plus video-to-video, Modify Video V2 for reshaping existing footage, Draft Mode, multi-keyframe control and Agents that 'generate, and refine', so a creator can rework an output rather than restart. However, no documented workflow shows iterating on a previously generated clip; 'extend a prior video' appears only as an FAQ question, and hands-on users said it was unclear how to get from a prompt to demo-quality results. missing for 10: an explicitly documented prompt-to-clip refinement loop (e.g., extending or editing a prior generation with a revised prompt), and independent hands-on corroboration of iterating on a generated result.

support.subject: As a creator, I can turn a text prompt into a video clip and iterate on the result without starting from scratch each time

citations.quote: text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video with character reference and keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR pipeline
Modify Video V2 reshapes footage you already have.
Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
Multi-Keyframe lets you set up to 16 keyframes inside a single clip.
